		ledger.MarkDossierSeen("scope1")
		ledger.MarkAnchorSeen("file.go")
		ledger.AcknowledgeGate("gate1")

		err := SaveLedger(dataDir, repoID, ledger)
		assert.NoError(t, err)

		assert.Equal(t, convID, loaded.ConversationID)

		assert.True(t, loaded.HasSeenDossier("scope1"))
		assert.True(t, loaded.HasSeenAnchor("file.go"))
		assert.True(t, loaded.IsGateAcknowledged("gate1"))
	})

	t.Run("Concurrent safe", func(t *testing.T) {
		ledger := delivery.NewLedger(convID)
		var wg sync.WaitGroup
		for i := 0; i < 10; i++ {
			wg.Add(1)
			go func() {
